guide.class_evidence: Sections 3.6.2 and 3.6.30 explicitly exclude adjectives before 고 나다 and 어 버리다. Section 3.6.33 licenses some adjective state-onset uses of 어 오다 while rejecting other adjective combinations.
guide.additional_unimplemented_restrictions: Printed pages 372–373 restrict 고 나다 right endings, honorific placement and tense on both owners. Page 527 restricts tense before 어 버리다. Page 544 distinguishes lexical adjective subsets and temporal uses of 어 오다. These require independent policy audits; existing judgments remain unchanged.

implementation: Entry-specific conflict rule continuation_verb for six connectors belonging to five exact native identities. 지-negatives carry the class dependency; other auxiliaries and copulas reset ownership. Explicit 답다 remains adjectival through licensed nominal suffixes. Unknown POS/providers remain visible. Existing conflicts, raw paths and native fields are preserved.
